desc: The ELR is a dedicated long-range hunting rifle built for those who chase distant targets. The target contour Christensen Arms carbon fiber wrapped barrel compliments the adjustable carbon fiber composite gunstock (with an enhanced grip angle and five flush cup mounts) and integral 20-MOA full picatinny rail to create a dependable platform for long-range applications. The titanium side-baffle muzzle brake saves additional weight. The ELR weighs in starting at 7.5 pounds and is backed by the Christensen Arms Sub-MOA Guarantee.
